name: House of Cards
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (1 card from a deck of cards per card placed)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one 5-ft. wall per 2 caster levels
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You toss a series of cards forming 5-foot-by-5-foot. Barriers that must be placed contiguously. The barriers cannot be placed in an area occupied by a creature. The wall is solid and has an AC of 10, hardness of 10, hit points equal to twice your caster level, and weakness to fire. If a section of wall is destroyed, the card itself is also destroyed. All other cards return to your deck at the end of the spell.
